findings.message: Catskills mews_hotel_id is mapped from the documented Hotel ID in docs/catskills-mews-ids.md; the other 3 locations remain NULL because no per-property Mews hotel ID is documented. It is editorial reference metadata, not an input to any Mews request.
76 amenities have no image-name/image-path columns in this export; image_name/image_path are NULL (no fabricated icon filenames).
76 published amenities carry editorial descriptions/visibility into amenity_editorial; image paths remain admin-authored and reseeding preserves published edits.
253 room-to-amenity references resolved into 253 relationship rows (21 restricted-amenity flags, all subsets of features-amenities).
1 of 22 room types are drafts in the export. Their status is written to room_type_publication so published-only D1 reads exclude them.
Publication state for 22 room types and 4 locations is imported into extension tables; editor-owned state survives reseeding.

5 of 8 events are recurring and used recurring-start as starts_at. Each event carries its property time zone and a DST-safe recurrence_rule (COW-40); recurring wall time is interpreted in that zone rather than a hard-coded Catskills offset.
3 of 8 offers have no Mews rate product ID; they are imported as draft/editorial-only (not bookable) and should be confirmed with Mews.
9 add-ons retained their non-empty Mews product IDs; validate them against Mews as the system of record.
Published Catskills site settings imported as a site_settings content item; draft edits cannot change guest behavior until publish.
190 provenance rows link imported records to the 2026-11-15 export and its source file hashes.

238 photo hotspots were NOT imported: the export has no photo-file-id/photo-url, so there is no legitimate media_asset_id. No placeholder FKs or FK-disabling were used. Re-export with media identity, then import hotspots and media_assets.
photo_hotspots.display-order has no column in the current D1 schema; add it in a migration before importing hotspots so editorial medallion order is preserved.
Duplicate export(s) skipped for buildings: 2026-11-15 - Buildings 2.csv (byte-identical after BOM normalization).
Duplicate export(s) skipped for outlets: 2026-11-15 - Outlets 2.csv (byte-identical after BOM normalization).
Menu Items export is empty; no import required.
instagrams: no dedicated D1 table; imported into content_items/content_revisions as a versioned content model (kind = instagram).
outlets: no dedicated D1 table; imported into content_items/content_revisions as a versioned content model (kind = outlet).
contentSettings: no dedicated D1 table; imported into content_items/content_revisions as a versioned content model (kind = policy).
content_settings is a draft in the export (isDraft=true, no lastPublished); its content_item status is 'draft' and will not appear in published APIs until approved.
